summary_en: This trial tests whether chemotherapy given before surgery, compared with surgery alone, helps people with high-risk retroperitoneal dedifferentiated liposarcoma or leiomyosarcoma. Before surgery, patients receive doxorubicin or epirubicin with ifosfamide (liposarcoma) or with dacarbazine (leiomyosarcoma), given every 3 weeks; the number of cycles is not stated. The study measures disease-free survival, and it is a Phase 3 trial.
summary_es: Este ensayo evalúa si la quimioterapia administrada antes de la cirugía, en comparación con la cirugía sola, ayuda a personas con liposarcoma dediferenciado o leiomiosarcoma retroperitoneal de alto riesgo. Antes de la cirugía, los pacientes reciben doxorubicina o epirubicina con ifosfamida (liposarcoma) o con dacarbazina (leiomiosarcoma), cada 3 semanas; el número de ciclos no se indica. El estudio mide la supervivencia libre de enfermedad y es un ensayo de fase 3.
who_for: Histologically proven high-risk leiomyosarcoma or liposarcoma of the retroperitoneum or pelvic infra-peritoneal space.
Tumor is resectable and has radiologically measurable disease.
Age 18 or older with WHO performance status 2 or lower.
Agrees to provide tumor tissue and blood samples for research, and gives written informed consent.
Women of childbearing potential have a negative pregnancy test and use highly effective birth control.
not_for: Sarcoma originating from bone, or from abdominal or gynecological organs.
Prior surgery, radiotherapy or systemic therapy for the current tumor (diagnostic biopsy allowed).
Prior anthracycline use at or above the stated maximum cumulative dose, or hypersensitivity to the study drugs.
Congestive heart failure, angina, recent heart attack within 1 year, uncontrolled arrhythmia, or uncontrolled hypertension.
